summary: Completed the Swift-only ROUND4 CPU/source revision in the authoritative editable .blend: localized wear/clouded crystal, selected fractured openings and exposed structure, finished cockpit housings/readable displays/controls/shaped seat/restraints, and protected canopy normals, rear tip and landing-foot geometry through LOD2. Preserved base/damaged/husked variants, passing silhouette/proportions/cultural design and three liveries. Promoted the exact current-source GLB after unmodified stock source/export validation, actual decoded surface/marker identity, topology/UV/normal audits and inspected CPU previews. Parent engine captures, full smoke, reliable whole-scene performance, independent blind grade and review remain pending; no whole-task or performance PASS is claimed.
decisions: Recover from history? → Verify equal Git pointer blobs at all three specified commits and SHA/size of the existing local LFS objects; hydrate only the two canonical Swift files → No fetch or old branch/debris imports; commit recovery separately before authoring.

Authoritative content? → Edit and save the .blend, with explicit authored LOD collections → Export entry point only consumes the saved source via stock validation/baking/export; it never imports author.py.
Round-3 disposition? → Treat the verbatim third verdict as REVISE → No fifth-grade waiver; parent must obtain a fresh blind grade.

Appearance corrections? → Contact masks around rung/grip/leading-edge/socket regions, distinct slate roughness and cloudy crystal; restore 16 displaced panels, remove 42 damaged and 46 husk floating replacement components, add 3/5 selected fracture sites → Address the specific material/destruction notes while keeping the passing hull design.

LOD defects? → Hold canopy and all three gear meshes exactly through LOD2, protect rear-tip vertices, retain four decreasing LODs → Verify actual vertices/faces/corner normals and decoded export, rather than chasing unattributed scene GPU timing.

Cockpit fit? → Author shaped seat/bolsters/head wings, harness/latch, fitted bezels, mesh labels/graphics, distinct rotary/toggle/pedal controls; fit existing ScreenLeft/Center/Right marker transforms to actual unchanged runtime plane dimensions → No Cockpit.js or runtime edits.

First author attempt exited 0 but failed the intended LOD3 budget → Keep 03-author/failed-source.blend and fix the inverted decimation group in 04 → A successful author process is not asset acceptance.

Cockpit fit checks failed in 17 and 19 (despite 19 directory name ending green) → Align marker scale/orientation and reverse side inset faces → Preserve failures and verify all 27 current LOD0/1/2 display instances.
Export attempts 16 and 20 cancelled when cockpit defects were found → Terminate and reap their process groups before further source edits → Never validate or promote a stale source/export pair.

Export 23 hit a disappearing scratch-file monitor race, not an asset/GPU failure → Preserve its failure log/receipt, make enumeration tolerate FileNotFoundError, prove the race in 24, reprove repeated-interrupt cleanup and exclusive ownership in 26 → One bounded retry at the same resource cap.

Export memory accumulation? → Release only reloadable decoded caches of packed maps after each stock material bake → Job25 proves exact float texels before/after release on a generated fixture and actual packed source mask; maps remain 4k and bake logic unchanged.

CPU preview qualification? → Use factory-started Blender, explicit CPU and two threads; strip stock turntable GPU discovery in memory without editing shared script → These images inform authoring only; they do not replace standard engine captures.

Failure scratch contains raw EXR tiles? → Record hashes/sizes and remove only own transient scratch after child-group-empty receipts → Preserve logs, failed source archives and visible partial artifacts without retaining raw frames.

Interruption orphaned Blender when the external harness killed the runner → Add an independent pipe watchdog, reproduce runner SIGKILL in 28 and repeated SIGTERM/SIGINT plus competing ownership in 29 → Command group termination/reaping now survives loss of the monitoring parent; job27 remains CANCELLED and unchanged.

Explicit continuation → Verify the same worktree, recovery HEAD, revised source SHA and absence of own active processes; continue from uncommitted source → No reset, rehydration, screenshot cleanup or other-checkout writes.

Export 33 completed baking and encoded 59 textures, then the stock tsx geometry tool failed listen EINVAL on its overlong Unix socket path → Reproduce the long-path failure and short-alias success in 34; route TMPDIR through an owned /tmp symlink to this attempt's scoped scratch → No shared tool edit; the alias is removed only after the child group is empty (normal and hard-loss proof 35).

Serializer reported invalid lower-LOD meshes → Disposable-copy probes 36/37 showed duplicate faces from decimation, not merely unused vertices → Remove duplicates in the saved source in 38, preserving unique triangle coverage and every LOD0 mesh; add duplicate-face/UV failure checks to the audit and validate authored LODs before saving. This is topology/source-export correctness, not performance-driven simplification.

Stock exporter deletes its temporary encoded file on later failure → Preserve the completed encoded stage in the fresh attempt before geometry compression → Label it INTERMEDIATE_NOT_VALIDATED; never import it into the source or promote it as canonical.

Export 41 passed geometry, compression and per-variant texture budgets but failed five uniform-normal checks → Author fine stone grain and crystal growth etching in those source materials, then bake and pack 4k normal maps while retaining their editable procedural nodes → Test actual surface UVs after stock UASTC before another full export; never waive the validator.

First targeted crystal normal in 42 remained below threshold; canonical source was not saved → Increase fine-etch depth/strength and repeat the bounded five-map authoring pass in 43 → All five compressed surface-UV deviations passed with margin (0.00967–0.01268 against 0.00392); geometry unchanged.

Monolithic export 47 reached the same 10000 MiB RSS cap when KTX overlapped retained Blender memory, after completing all source bakes and serialization → Preserve its receipt and exact SHA-pinned raw stage, terminate/reap, then split stock compression and stock validation into fresh bounded processes → No cap increase, source regeneration, rejected asset import, or repeated full bake.

Actual decoded comparison 50 rejected the stock-default candidate despite stock PASS: position quantization collapsed tiny bevels, UV quantization collapsed narrow islands, and some corner normals diverged → Check a bounded 16-bit candidate in 51/52; preserve its remaining failures → Do not relax identity tolerances or alter source geometry to fit the codec.

Precision resolution → Keep authored float32 positions/UVs, quantize normals/tangents at 16 bits, and use stock lossless meshopt stream compression → Both KHR_mesh_quantization and EXT_meshopt_compression remain genuinely required; no shared family/tool edit. Candidate 56 has 24,721,000 bytes and passes the unchanged identity gate in 57 across 127 surface groups and all 12 variant/LOD combinations.

Normal-only quantization library omission → glTF-Transform 4.5.1 isQuantizedPrimitive reads POSITION for each semantic, missing quantized NORMALs; explicitly declare their required extension and assert actual signed-short normal accessors → 53 and diagnostic55 retain failures; 54 was an erroneously started missing-candidate check and failed without promotion. Applied codec settings are in successful56/compression.json; 53 input-stage defaults were preliminary and never produced an asset.

Paired CPU rear previews 61/62 showed the copied lower-LOD canopy floating above its cockpit despite identical local mesh signatures → Probe64 found nine lost parent-inverse transforms; fix65 restores them in the authoritative source, with all mesh signatures, packed images and every other world transform unchanged → Extend source audit to compare world transforms, preserve the defective images, and regenerate the export from the saved source.

Corrected-source export after canopy hierarchy fix → Fully run stock source validation, 4k bake and serialization in 68; all 59 fresh PNG image bytes and material/texture bindings exactly match the completed 48 texture stage → Reuse only its KTX2 encodings with byte equality proofs, retain fresh geometry buffers and nodes byte-for-byte, and apply the tested Swift precision policy in 69. No cached geometry or old asset is imported into source.

Later parent release retains the screenshot-cleanup hold → Finalizer performs no image or scratch deletion and records the two pre-existing interrupted Cycles EXR tile buffers from 20/27 as retained failure data → These are disclosed separately from compact previews and counted conservatively toward file/byte caps; no new raw-frame deliverable is generated.

Final promotion? → Require matching source SHA across source audit, display fit, stock validation and actual decoded identity, plus inspected final CPU images → Job84 promotes only candidate5873c5c; job85 rechecks recovery and the unchanged R3 packet. Stage72 was reused without restarting and no additional export was launched after the parent release.
